_comment: compare-script-output.py の selftest の歯を、 比べ方の要所を 1 つずつ外した mutant で確かめる spec (claude-config の check-foil-teeth.py で回す)。

mutants.name: 出力を比べない
pairs: if a == b and rc_old == rc_new == 0:
expect_pass: a refactor with the same output and a different timing is SAME

mutants.name: 終了値を比べない
pairs: if a == b and rc_old == rc_new == 0:
expect_fail: a changed exit code with the same text is reported
a script that fails on both sides does not pass

mutants.name: 時間の mask を外す
expect_fail: a refactor with the same output and a different timing is SAME

mutants.name: 2 つの root を揃えない
expect_fail: the two roots are not a difference

mutants.name: --link を張らない
expect_fail: an input outside the archive is shared with --link

mutants.name: 追加の mask を当てない
expect_fail: an extra --mask hides only what it names
expect_pass: a refactor with the same output and a different timing is SAME
